title: Learning special arrangements with help from Gene Ware and Louis Nelson
summary: Struggling with Ellington-style arrangements like Black and Tan Fantasy, he was coached on reading, attack and dynamics.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
